item.title: Motorists, passengers stranded as FAAN enforces cashless toll at Lagos airport
item.description: Traffic movement around the tollgate leading to the Murtala Muhammed Airport was severely disrupted on Sunday after the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria, FAAN, began enforcing a new cashless payment system for vehicles entering the airport. item.title: Lagos residents groan as tenants pay millions for substandard housing
item.description: Residents of Lagos are grappling with an unprecedented surge in house rents, as accommodation costs across the metropolis continue to rise sharply amid worsening living conditions.
